name: 2025_sarpanch_results
title: Telangana 2025 sarpanch seats, from the State Election Commission's reports
description: One row per gram panchayat (GP) in the commission's per-mandal 'Only Elected' (E) or 'All Contested' (A) reports.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State

fields.name: year
fields.description: Election year

fields.name: district
fields.description: District, as on the commission's form

fields.name: block
fields.description: Mandal, as on the commission's form

fields.name: gram_panchayat
fields.description: GP name as printed

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Pooled tier

fields.name: tier_local
fields.description: Local name of the post

fields.name: reserved_label
fields.description: Pooled reservation label of the seat

fields.name: reserved_caste
fields.description: Seat's caste category (UR printed as NONE)

fields.name: reserved_woman
fields.description: 1 if the seat is reserved for a woman

fields.name: reserved_raw
fields.description: Commission's code: category, then (G)eneral or (W)oman

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Elected sarpanch as printed in the E report; null if the GP is not in it

fields.name: winner_basis
fields.description: 'published' where the E report names a winner

fields.name: party
fields.description: Not reported (non-party polls); always null

fields.name: unopposed
fields.description: 1 if the A report lists one candidate and zero valid votes; null if the GP is not in the A report

fields.name: script
fields.description: Script of names

fields.name: district_id
fields.description: Commission's district code

fields.name: mandal_id
fields.description: Commission's mandal code within the district; mostly two digits, but some newer mandals carry a long code (Bheemaram, Jagtial: 302152)

fields.name: gp_code
fields.description: Commission's GP code within the mandal, from the GP dropdown; null if the name is missing or repeated there

fields.name: result_declared
fields.description: True if the E report names a winner

fields.name: in_reports
fields.description: Which mandal reports hold the GP

fields.name: listed_twice
fields.description: True if the E report prints this GP twice (same GP code); the repeat row is dropped

fields.name: reserved_raw_a
fields.description: Reservation code in the A report's GP caption

fields.name: candidates
fields.description: Candidates listed in the A report

fields.name: elected_count
fields.description: Candidates marked Elected in the A report

fields.name: elected_name
fields.description: Candidate marked Elected in the A report

fields.name: total_valid_votes
fields.description: Valid votes (A caption)

fields.name: rejected_votes
fields.description: Rejected votes (A caption)

fields.name: tendered_votes
fields.description: Tendered votes (A caption)

fields.name: nota_votes
fields.description: NOTA votes (A caption)

fields.name: a_path
fields.description: A report file holding the GP

fields.name: a_locator
fields.description: GP caption position in the A report

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Committed raw file the row was read from (gzipped as .gz)

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Endpoint the raw file was fetched from (POST form)

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Position in the raw file
